structuredServiceItem.description: Gutters vacuum cleaned from the ground with a SkyVac. Leaves, moss, silt and debris out, with no ladders and no mess. A camera on the pole shows inside your gutters, and you get before and after photos. Three-storey houses and flats are no problem. From £34.99.

label.description: Blocked downpipes cleared with your gutter clean, so the water in your gutters has somewhere to go and drains away properly.
Grimy, green fascias and soffits cleaned, so your roofline looks fresh again. The perfect finishing touch after a gutter clean.
Roof moss and debris cleared at the source, before it washes down and blocks your gutters again.

structuredServiceItem.description: Driveways, patios, paths and steps power washed. Moss, algae and ground-in dirt lifted from block paving, so it looks like new again.

label.description: Minor repairs to gutters, downpipes and rooflines: leaking joints, loose or broken brackets, sagging gutters and downpipes that have come away. Ask us and we'll let you know if we can fix it.
